env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^sum: 12$'
stdout '^alpha$'
stdout '^beta$'
stdout '^//line main\.lgo:999$'
stdout '^delta$'
stdout '^fields: 3$'
stdout '^total: 27$'
cmp stdout expected.txt
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
! exists out/main.lgo

! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep '^import$' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectlitpos

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
	Ok    bool
}

func summed() int {
	s := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		s += []int{1, 2, 3}.map(x => x + f.Index).sum()
	}
	return s
}

var payload = `alpha
beta

//line main.lgo:999
delta
`

func main() {
	xs := []int{1, 2, 3}.map(x => x * 2).sum()
	fmt.Println("sum:", xs)
	/* keep payload bytes verbatim: the lines below are string data,
	   including the blank line and the //line-looking line */
	fmt.Printf("%s", payload)
	/* payload printed verbatim above */
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Row]() {
		n += f.Index
	}
	fmt.Println("fields:", n)
	fmt.Println("total:", summed())
}

-- m/expected.txt --
sum: 12
alpha
beta

//line main.lgo:999
delta
fields: 3
total: 27
